title: Smiling Mother and Toddler Son Outside, 1948 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Michael & Mummy July 1948 at Aunt Mildred's 2 1/2 yrs old 0864
description: A candid 1948 black-and-white snapshot depicting a smiling mother sitting beside her two-and-a-half-year-old son, Michael, outdoors next to a house with horizontal lap siding and a brick base. The mother wears a mid-century striped day dress with soft curls typical of post-WWII women's fashion, while the young boy sits on a small wooden bench wearing shortalls. The photograph captures the simple domestic warmth and suburban lifestyle of late-1940s American family life.
